title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Navigator's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the verified return bearing; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
